a_capture_record_must: name the producer module it launched, resolve this chain's head, and carry the resolved kind beside the verbatim ExecMainStatus; a producer absent from the head is recorded UNMAPPED by name
chain_head_rule: vN+1 by the {path, sha256} pair; readers resolve the chain head by the <family>_v<N>.json glob and follow the pair; ONE producer's block is added or changed per version, by that producer, with the pair from the head it read; v1 is never edited; IMMUTABLE ONCE LANDED: a landed version file is never modified -- a landing whose diff shows M on an existing version (instead of A on a new one) is a refusal, and a producer versioning the chain re-reads the head AFTER its rebase/copy and before its commit; if the head moved, it re-versions from the new head
declared_by: coordinator (R-711): CHAIN REPAIR by pair -- restores the blocks two landings overwrote; resolves REV 80 §2.1 rc-1 collision

codes.0: the run's own verdict is affirmative: PRE_READ_VERIFIED on the pre-read path, or IS_A_VERIFICATION_OF_THE_ECONOMICS on the full read
codes.1: FLAGGED -- a comparison RAN and disagreed: an arm, a digest a receipt declares, or a leaked sealed name. A VERDICT, not a crash
codes.2: the CLI was mis-invoked (argparse's own usage exit, via ap.error). Not a reading of any day
codes.3: INCOMPLETE or PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE -- the seal HOLDS and a named half was not attempted or an input a conjunct needs is missing. A VERDICT by name; the record's `incomplete_because` carries the reasons

live/pm_research/da_gate1_day_verdict.py.declared_after: DA 99 and DA 100 ran this producer under the lock and its 3 was UNMAPPED in the register (R-709)

not_declared_here.75: NEVER: 75 is the WRAPPER's refusal (a held lock exits the unit with it). A producer that declared it would make a lock conflict read as one of its own verdicts
not_declared_here.any_other_non_zero: an uncaught exception -- a CRASH, recorded verbatim as UNMAPPED. This producer raises VerifierRefused for every refusal it can name, and a traceback is not a verdict

live/pm_research/da_gate1_day_verdict.py.where_the_verdict_is_written: the record named by --output; the exit code is a summary of `status`, never the record itself

codes.1: FLAGGED -- the read artifact exists and something in it disagrees with this verifier's recomputation, or a day the pins name is not SAID. A VERDICT
codes.2: a REFUSAL this verifier names, printed to STDOUT where argparse never writes (READ_ARTIFACT_ABSENT_THE_READ_HAS_NOT_BEEN_OPENED, PINS_DECLARATION_ABSENT, a pin that does not hold, and the rest). Separable from argparse's own usage exit 2 by STREAM and by STRING

reading_kinds.declared code: a VERDICT by name, resolved in the producer's block
reading_kinds.undeclared non-zero: UNMAPPED -- a number observed and nothing learned; NOT a refusal, NOT a failure, and it does NOT satisfy a GO conditioned on that run (the predicate is not evaluable; the GO waits, the producer declares the code by pair, the record is re-read)

runtime_default.1: the interpreter's uncaught exception. A producer's OWN block may declare 1 as a crash (or otherwise); a producer with NO block gets no default: rc 1 from it is UNMAPPED (REV 80 §2.1 -- UNMAPPED wins over the default; a producer that has declared nothing has declared nothing)

sibling_of.why_a_sibling: the form's constants are the WRAPPER's (lock path, conflict code, caps) and belong to every producer alike; an exit map is one producer's own and would make the shared form change whenever any producer added a code (REV 79 §2.1)

supersedes.rule: 13 -- vN+1 by the {path, sha256} PAIR; the prior version is NOT edited
supersedes.what_changes: BE's four blocks and DE's block RESTORED byte-identical from the commits that carried them (a chain repair, the one version that carries more than one producer -- disclosed); runtime_default rewritten so UNMAPPED wins for rc 1 from a producer with no block; chain_head_rule gains immutability

what: One block per producer that runs under the heavy-run lock: {exit code: meaning}. A capture record resolves a non-zero ExecMainStatus HERE, never in the producer's source. A code with no entry is recorded VERBATIM as UNMAPPED and is not a reading.
what_this_is_not: not a list of the wrapper's five fields (heavy_run_form), not a permission (a declared code is a reading, decisions live in the policy layer, rule 14)

75.meaning: EX_TEMPFAIL -- the heavy-run lock is held; the unit did NO work and wrote nothing (rule 20)
75.owner: the launch form (flock -n -E 75 inside the unit)
75.where_enforced: a producer whose declared block contains 75 is refused at its own selftest (REV 68 §3.2)

chain_repair.what_happened: three producers versioned this chain from v1 within five minutes (BE 75 a81484c, DE 108 ba635de, DA 101 40c8903), each writing producer_exit_maps_v2.json from v1's pair; the shared-tree landings turned the second and third into MODIFICATIONS of v2 (git: M, not A), so the file at v2 is DA's and BE's and DE's blocks left the chain while their rows said DECLARED
chain_repair.checker: scripts/declaration_immutability.sh -- a version file with more than one commit in its history is FORKED_BY_EDIT
